limit.LABEL: IPv6 rDNS Limit
limit.PLACEHOLDER: Maximum IPv6 PTR records each client can create per IP entity. Admins are not limited.

nameservers.LABEL: Name Servers
nameservers.PLACEHOLDER: Comma-separated list of all public-facing nameservers. The master nameserver should be listed first. Example: hostmaster.synergycp.com, ns1.synergycp.com, ns2.synergycp.com
